dek.en: In the three weeks before mainnet, members ship games, a city, leaderboards and design tools, the team spends Token2049 talking to traders, and a teaser counts to a million.

en: This back issue covers 1 to 19 October, the last days before mump2p went live on mainnet; issue 001 picks up the story on 20 October. Those nineteen days belonged to the community more than the company.

In a fortnight members shipped a voxel shooter, a walkable city with a rodeo mini game, a learning game, an endless runner, two leaderboards and a design tool, and hosted Roblox nights and weekly game schedules on Discord. Propagator’s community projects page exists because of that wave.
Between 9 and 17 October members released Block Arena, Optimum World, Optimum: Beyond the Block, Optimum Maker, two Discord leaderboards and Optimum Data Dash.

At Token2049 in Singapore Optimum co-hosted an agentic trading afternoon with ambr, and Muriel Médard spoke with CNA. Optimum told the Lido forum it would limit acceleration to registered operators after 26 October.
On 19 October Optimum teased a number, 1,000,000, a day before mainnet. October’s four role calls named 51 members.

body.en: On 9 October Keng SiRô released Block Arena, a voxel shooter built with Three.js for the Optimum community, and added character selection and real multiplayer on 17 October. Around the same day baised opened Optimum World, a small city to walk through, where an inside joke from the Discord became a rodeo mini game. On 10 October DraganD98 released Optimum: Beyond the Block, a game for learning about RLNC and mump2p, and on 17 October Lie released Optimum Data Dash, an endless runner about collecting data shards.

body.en: Members also built tools. On 12 October WeLoSu released Optimum Maker, which keeps visuals made with AI on Optimum’s own brand. On 16 October PixelRey_x launched a community leaderboard site for exploring Discord activity, and on 17 October DexBlocker launched Optimum Contributor Hub, where members connect Discord to see how their contributions stack up. Capzz’s live quiz tournament Aethlos also dates from this week.

The regional communities ran their own events. On 14 October Indonesian members diikzzyy__ and Sorosiona hosted a Roblox Pass the Bomb night that players wrote about the next day, and on 18 October a weekly schedule went round with a Poxel game on Mondays and Bomb Party, a word game, on Tuesdays. Members described quizzes, karaoke and poker as part of the Optimum experience. The weekly community call on 8 October, led by BlockchainJeff, covered technology, roadmap and community growth.

sources: MS DHONI on X, community call recap

body.en: The team was in Singapore for Token2049 week. On 6 October Optimum co-hosted an afternoon on agentic trading and AI agents at the ambr offices, and on 7 October it attended DAS Asia. Its message had shifted toward traders: equity trading is moving onchain, Optimum wrote, and equity traders value low latency above almost everything. Médard also gave an interview to the Singapore broadcaster CNA, which Optimum shared for its Chinese speaking followers, on what the industry needs to keep growing.

On 12 October Optimum answered the independent StereumLabs test on Lido’s forum. Global acceleration had been active for all nodes during the measurement, it said, which may have masked mump2p’s effect, and after 26 October acceleration would be limited to registered operators. Lido’s own summary of its Hoodi trial, published three days after mainnet, found blocks arriving 407 ms sooner at the 95th percentile and 45% fewer wrong head votes.

On 19 October Optimum posted a single number, 1,000,000, and promised that all would be revealed soon. The next day mump2p went live on Ethereum mainnet with more than 1.4 million ETH behind its operators. That story is in issue 001.

title.en: A city you can walk through

body.en: baised built Optimum a small city: walk its streets, meet the team and community members as characters, and find the rodeo where a running joke from the Discord became a mini game. It is the closest thing to visiting Optimum, and other builders link to it; Block Arena has a portal into it.

note.en: 4 role calls in October, posted on 6, 13, 19 and 26 October by Flash in #role-announcements. Every member named has a page on the register. The role call of 26 October came after mainnet launched; it is included so the month is complete.
